pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit complex, starlike geometries with highly irregular, jagged edges. Pixel gradients at edges are sharp. Spatial area of patches is larger and more elongated on the neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the posterior flank and leg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes typically show three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the flank, with slight widening and increased irregularity at the junction nodes in the cervical region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck presents as a short, vertical fringe. The 1D silhouette against the background shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged contour.
